d:
I'm on a bit of a roll with these. I like this artist a lot, and he's done quite a few of these short manga, so I plan to knock out a few more before I move on. Next time will be one with a fox, because I love foxes.

Thanks as always to Mr. Bibble. Whether he means to or not, he's always digging up the best kemono stuff and bringing it to where I'll see it.

You can find the raw here:
